question: After the activation defect, merge conflicts, upgrade proof, and live-proof gaps are resolved, should phase one ship local snapshot-branch continuation plus confirmation-gated native archive while paired-node sessions remain read-only?
rationale: Source review supports the mechanics, but accepting process-local status uncertainty, operator confirmation as archive fencing, guided enablement, and persistent model-locked session creation requires explicit product and security risk ownership.

options.title: Approve bounded phase one
options.body: Keep local snapshot branches and confirmation-gated archive, keep remote rows read-only, and land after all correctness, upgrade, conflict, and proof gates pass.

options.title: Narrow to read-only consolidation
options.body: Ship only the single-plugin catalog ownership change and defer continuation, archive, and guided enablement to a later separately reviewed PR.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded phase one
recommendation.body: Keep local snapshot branches and confirmation-gated archive, keep remote rows read-only, and land after all correctness, upgrade, conflict, and proof gates pass.
